answer: Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the vertex forfeiture publishes up in the delta totals with the nadir audit listing each retired key. An operator that abandons 182 aliases after a single epoch therefore destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Retiring an identity early forfeits 37% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
